title: The Creation of Adam (Michelangelo)
moodDescription: Renaissance sacred grandeur contrasting earthly solitude with divine creation

regions.label: Adam (Earthly Being)
regions.spokenLabel: On the left, Adam lies recumbent upon the grassy hillside, his muscular earthly form yearning upward, waiting for the breath of life.
regions.timbreDescription: Warm solo cello and resonant acoustic bass

regions.label: God the Father
regions.spokenLabel: God the Father rushes forward enveloped in divine majesty, arm outstretched toward Adam with immense creative power.
regions.timbreDescription: Cathedral choir and grand pipe organ swell

regions.label: The Near Touch (Spark of Life)
regions.spokenLabel: The iconic focal point where the index finger of God and the finger of Adam almost touch, suspended in eternal electric anticipation.
regions.timbreDescription: Luminous crystal harp & celestial bell arpeggios

regions.label: Crimson Cloak & Cherubim
regions.spokenLabel: A billowing red cosmic shroud resembling a human brain, sheltering God and a multitude of wingless angels in swirling harmony.
regions.timbreDescription: Swelling orchestral strings and warm brass

regions.label: Landscape & Open Ether
regions.spokenLabel: The pale, luminous ether and gentle green slope of Eden, simple and serene, framing the cosmic drama.
regions.timbreDescription: Tranquil open air and gentle wind harmonics
